Token Tuesday: Apes

Today on Token Tuesday, Emily Smirle has served up for you the Apes of various sizes. DFRPG lists several unarmed Apes that we're covering today: The Flesh Eating Ape, The Giant Ape and the Giant Ape's bigger incarnation, the Silverback.
